<quote by="Proposed: Conscience of the Senate, Seconded: Tassato">Motion to commission and that there be a disbursal of funds to construct a Counting House in Tassato.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[folly]] in [[Tassato]] that increases the Virtue Fund as per the '''[[Forwards and Rewards]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
==Date==
* Winter 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 5 wains of weirwood
* 5 wains of white granite
* 30 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Tassato_Counting_House}}
==Outcome==
* Once the work is complete, the [[Rewarding|Virtue Fund]] will receive 16 crowns each summit in donations from citizens of the territory
